recipes.name: Espresso Martini
instructions: Place the vodka, kahlua and espresso in a cocktail shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously 10 times, then pour briskly into a cocktail glass. (Scrape out foam inside if necessary)
Garnish wtih 3 coffee beans and serve immediately.

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: TIPS: Cool the coffee so it doesn’t melt the ice = won’t dilute drink flavour Espresso coffee from a proper coffee machine = nice crema (foam) on coffee = nice foam layer on surface of Espresso Martini Can’t get foam on Espresso Martini with coffee granules, French Press coffee marker or similar. Need a proper machine! No coffee machine? Cheat! Add 1/2 egg white and shake, it will create a gorgeous foam layer but you will not be able to taste it at all! Need foam for the coffee beans to float! Recipe source: Absolut Drinks (makers of Absolut vodka(
